notes: [junkwell-01. Variant for fleet 1918bb5 (toolclean-01), branch jw-on-1918bb5 @ 911d792 (bots/src identical to fd3044b; 911d792 changes only scripts/host/wellread.py). Launch: ~/chain-after.sh toolclean-01 junkwell-01 1918bb5=/home/mike/mcai-analysis/junkwell-01.1918bb5.json -- STOPs if the fleet is not 1918bb5; if toolclean-01 is REVERTED the well is rebased onto 56db2cd and re-registered.] OWNER 10-04: vanilla 5-minute despawn accepted as the INTERIM disposal; the listed junk has no use: egg, brown_egg, blue_egg, flint, clay_ball, ink_sac, glow_ink_sac, armadillo_scute (+ dead_bush, pointed_dripstone, rail). NEVER cobblestone, ballast, tools, food, wood, saplings, ores, or anything the composter takes; never tossed anywhere but into the well; no admin world edits (the bot builds it in survival). THE CHANGE: one town junk well (bots/src/well.mjs): a 1x1 shaft two deep at a canonical site >= 7 from home, bank containers and the composter; a wooden trapdoor bottom-half on the floor and a second top-half as a flush cap (clear height 1.625 < creeper 1.7; items 1.8125 below a rim player's feet, out of the 0.75 pickup reach). Deterministic town orders only (never the model): build_well (pit-first when a full bag holds junk: dig, throw junk down the open pit to make the craft's room), dispose_well (at town, >= 34 slots, listed junk; no other player within 5, re-checked immediately before the open; whole stacks by single container THROW clicks from <= 1.15 on the front or a side stand, aimed with vanilla drop ballistics; the bag held and server-resynced; the cap closed in a finally; misses retaken), close_well (any visitor closes an open well nobody is at). Every movement profile excludes the well column (cap-1 .. cap+10) from steps and the walls/floor/ring from breaks, except a body INSIDE its own well (break ring + steps at cap level and below). REVIEWS: Codex 9 rounds (final AGREE fd3044b); independent Claude review CHANGE -> all FIXED, approved 8f73e80; the approval round's minor finding (an unloaded neighbour read as a breach) fixed in fd3044b. PAPER SANDBOX 1.21.8 (sandbox/well/well-e2e.cjs): build pit-first from a 36/36 bag of logs + junk (cap top/closed/facing, floor trapdoor, 18 items in the shaft, 0 outside); dispose 9 stacks / 432 items all in the shaft at +1.5 s and +30 s, non-listed untouched, server-resynced; walker isolation 60 passes + 20 s on the cap with the positive-control egg collected: 0 picked from the well; admission: refused with a player at 3.0 blocks, cap never opened, then disposed 198 s after the player left; creeper spawner A/B: control shaft without the floor trapdoor 1, the well 0; escape from inside an open well: out in 6-7 s by digging a wall, never sealed in; race: an arrival after the cap opened sees it close ~1.1 s after the last throw. KNOWN / REGISTRATION NOTES: (1) the death gate is unchanged (two-death floor); (2) a build digs 1-2 shaft blocks whose drops fall into the shaft and despawn with the junk; (3) the SIDE-stand throw rate (1.0) was checked only in the ballistic model, never on Paper (Paper threw from the front stand); (4) despawn pauses in an unloaded chunk (items stay contained); (5) the fleet is peaceful, so the mob geometry is for 'any world'; (6) raw reflex digs (entombment, pillarOut) ignore the break exclusion -- the worst case is a breached well, which is never thrown into and is rebuilt; (7) chest-full's chestSiteRefusal does not yet reserve the stands (wellReservedCells exported for the rebase) -- a chest on all three stands = breach = rebuild; (8) dispose-first withdraw integration is the NEXT canary, not this one; (9) a well must be BUILT before any disposal: the first build needs a bot at town with 2-3 logs of one wood (or 6 planks/2 trapdoors) and room or junk to make room.

licence.note: Written only by this build (one row per disposal visit, pit-first phase and visitor close). The fleet (1918bb5) has no _well_* row of any kind and no well in any world (no code builds one).

require.name: full bots at town (compost runs pass the same at-town, >= 34-slot, 3-min-cooldown gate a dispose order uses)

draw_exposure.note: min 8 ROWS = ~4 compost runs: drawexposure counts both the compost skill row and its _compost event (board-b 14 rows = 7 runs). drawexposure 10-05 09:57Z with min 8: eligible board-b 14, board-c 8, board-d 8, hive-b 8, hive-c 14, placebo-a 32, placebo-b 10 (not board-a 4, hive-a 2, hive-d 0, placebo-d 0). 10-05 ~03:50Z..09:50Z compost runs per pool (6 h): board-a 2, board-b 7, board-c 4, board-d 4, hive-a 1, hive-b 5, hive-c 7, hive-d 0, isolated-a 19, isolated-b 3, isolated-c 13, isolated-d 8, placebo-a 16, placebo-b 5, placebo-c 6, placebo-d 0. Fleet 12.6 compost orders per 10 bots per 6 h; 58% of control bots at >= 34 slots hold listed junk (40-46 of ~70 in the dry runs).

exposure.note: Ready = >= 3 canary disposal visits that the server bag confirms (n > 0) AND the positive control >= 1 (control bots at >= 34 slots holding listed junk: 40-46 in the dry runs 10-05). Expected: a well must first be built (one per drawn town); then ~7-12 dispose orders per 6 h on 10 bots (the compost gate's 12.6 per 10 bots per 6 h, times the listed-junk share among full bots), minus player_near refusals (reported per order).

own_lines.note: C1: a bot collected an item lying in a well's shaft (_well_recollected, or recollected= > 0 on a visit).

C2: a cap left open (_well_left_open / _well_open_unresolved) that no row of the same pool showed READ BACK closed (cap_end=closed) within 2 min. A transient row a visitor fixed is reported, not gated.

C3: a thrown item entity the SERVER names off the list (offlist= > 0), an off-list name in items=, or nonlisted= > 0. Positive control asserted in the read; the fake server's iron-for-rail substitution fires it (bots/test/well.test.mjs).
C4: a bot STUCK inside a well -- its _well_inside rows at one cell spanning >= 2 min (no escape). A single inside row (a fall it dug out of; Paper: out in 6-7 s) is a named tripwire.
C5: thrown misses not retaken on completed visits (a miss another bot took counts as left out). Junk thrown anywhere but the well is the owner's line.
C6: more than one ACTIVE well in a pool (built minus breached/_well_retired; a designed rebuild is not a breach).
Arms: control runs the base code and writes no _well_* row. BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS: canary _well_* rows from the canary build. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
POSITIVE CONTROL: control bots at >= 34 slots holding listed junk are visible to this query (40-46 in the dry runs). BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: listed-junk slots per bot DiD (eggs stack to 16), share of bots at >= 34 slots DiD (noisy between pools: -0.34..+0.31 in no-change dry runs), items out, slots freed per visit, refusals per dispose order by reason, no_site per pool, tripwires (inside rows, caps found open, other_loss, unnamed, pits left open, aborted-visit misses, deaths within 3 of a well).

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid. A death within 3 of a well is named in wellread, never a verdict.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. Wells and any open pits stay in the world after a REVERT: closed caps are inert; base code has no exclusion, and a 2-deep pit is an ordinary hole base bots can tower or dig out of.
